svg.title: Green Sea seasonal sea-trade routes
svg.desc: Provisional trade network from Trading in the Green Sea. Cropped directly from taelgar-basemap.jpg, the basemap used by the Green Sea climatic model. North up. Small hexes are 24 miles face to face. Routes depict water-only regional corridors and offshore port approaches, not precise harbor locations. The Volta river leg is deliberately omitted. The common Cymean strait passage is rendered separately with a thin line and enlarged inset. Arrowheads show voyage direction, not winds or currents. Source coordinates are the climate overlays' 1907 by 1280 reference plane.

g.text: GREEN SEA · SEASONAL TRADE NETWORKS
Sea routes and port approaches · working model · sailing opportunities vary by itinerary
CYMEAN STRAITS · ENLARGED
Thin dark line = common passage through the straits.
The upstream journey to Tollen is outside this sea-only map.
TOLLEN → URSK
April–June: northern outward passage.
Zakat and farther authorized Ursk ports.
URSK → TOLLEN
July–August: westward summer return.
The ordinary northern round trip finishes the same year.
CYMEAN EXCHANGE
Dotted links: proposed exchange ports; itinerary varies.
The straits connect them to Tollen and its guild network.
MEDJU → PENINSULA
Late March–April: westward spring departure.
The route rounds the peninsula through open water.
PENINSULA → URSK
May–June: offshore northward passage.
Keeps well west of Irrla’s hazardous northern shores.
PENINSULA → SVOLHAS
June–July: alternative summer destination.
Approaches Irrla’s trading coast from the south.
AUTUMN ISLAND ITINERARIES
Ursk OR Svolhas → Wahacha region → Quanyi → Medju.
September–November sailing; December arrival at Medju.
SOUTHEASTERN REGIONAL TRADE
Grey dotted links: reciprocal seasons remain unresolved.
Connections between markets, not a mandatory circuit.
Arrows show voyages. Open circles mark offshore approaches or market areas, not exact harbors. Corridors are provisional; local pilotage is not mapped.
NORTH UP · SMALL HEXES: 24 MILES FACE TO FACE · TAELGAR BASEMAP
